candidate_workaround: Run Git status and untracked-file discovery as independent processes with separate timeouts and receipts.
failure_signature: A combined repository-state wrapper times out and discards both status and untracked-count evidence.
recurrence_guard: Do not combine potentially slow Git worktree scans under one short process budget.
rollback: Give the timed wrapper zero evidence credit and rerun only the required probes independently.
title: Independent receipts for slow Git worktree probes
trigger_preconditions: A large Windows worktree requires status and untracked-file inventory before staging.
